reference: AN2019_016_v9 section 4.1; Run-3 ID-only tag-and-probe revision with independent HLT_IsoMu24 tag

campaign_inputs.run2024i_policy: Use Muon0 and Muon1 standard MINIv6NANOv15 productions and exclude duplicated Run2024I MINIv6NANOv15_v2 inputs. ParkingDoubleMuonLowMass is forbidden for this ID-only measurement because its double-muon trigger conditions the probe.

binning_policy: Count and fit an initial 4x5 grid. Any later merging must be an exact post-reduction sum justified by fit stability; NanoAOD files must not be reread for alternative coarser candidates.
target_selection: looseId; miniPFRelIso_all is not part of the probe pass/fail definition
denominator: reconstructed tracker muon with 5 < pT < 10 GeV and abs(eta) < 2.4, without a LooseID or mini-isolation requirement
tag: tight high-purity muon with pT > 26 GeV and miniPFRelIso_all < 0.1 matched to the HLT_IsoMu24 trigger object
trigger_object_bit_source: CMSSW_15_0_X PhysicsTools/NanoAOD triggerObjects_cff.py muon quality bit 1: Iso; verified in Run2024C Muon0 data and Summer24 J/psi MC with a pT>26 tag
reference_trigger_strategy: HLT_IsoMu24 and its pT>26 GeV Iso-bit-matched tag select the event. The tracker-muon probe is not required to pass a trigger leg, LooseID, mini-isolation, or trigger-object matching. Double-muon paths and ParkingDoubleMuonLowMass data are excluded.
adoption_gates: probe denominator audit proves LooseID and mini-isolation are absent
Muon_isTracker branch presence in data and simulation
data inputs are exclusively Muon0/Muon1 and no double-muon reference path is configured
tag pT > 26 GeV and HLT_IsoMu24 Iso-bit matching are present in every adopted shard
5--6 and 6--7 GeV probe bins have statistically usable pass and fail samples
simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted bin
bin-by-bin scale-factor stability under fit-model, fit-window, binning, and pileup variations
